question: After the frozen first materialized family was not evaluable, which still-unmaterialized independent 3RScan family is next under the unchanged metadata-only ordering?

selection.ranking: Use the unchanged predecessor candidate ordering. Exclude consumed targets, used reference families, and every candidate for which either scan now has any of semseg, instance PLY, or sequence materialized; select the first remaining row. No RGB, pose, depth, geometry or model output participates.

post_download_gate.source_is_evaluable_only_if: Both fixed target instances have at least one independently selected frame satisfying every rule before RGB/model access.

forbidden_after_freeze: replace the selected family, target or six-file plan after materialization
open RGB or run a model before the post-download gate
relax visibility, short-side or aspect rules
claim a metadata candidate is evaluable or algorithm evidence
claim_boundary: This second freeze selects one official metadata-only download candidate after a source-not-evaluable result. It is not source evaluability, algorithm evidence, portal identity, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
